family: Set f_0=0. For n>=1 let k be the least prime exceeding ceil((24/25)*n^(3/5)). Return 0 if k>=n. The last k input bits specify the coefficients of a monic degree-k binary polynomial h below its leading term. Pad the first N=n-k bits on the right with zeros into r=ceil(N/k) blocks X_j, least-degree coefficient first, in F_2[Z]/(h). For j=1,...,r set u_j=r+1-j. Output the constant coefficient of the elementary symmetric polynomial of degree ceil(sqrt(r)) on the r values X_j^(2^u_j-1), using the degree-<k representative. The selector coefficients are in increasing degree order.
theorem: For this one fixed total polynomial-time family, with an empty-witness NP verifier, there is an N_0 such that at every integer actual input length n>=N_0, every exact nonuniform single-output full-B2 circuit for f_n has at least 4*n-(61/4)*n^(4/5) gates. In particular liminf C_B2(f_n)/n >= 4 over all integer lengths.
